name: mcp-backbone
description: Explore a database's schema and run safe, read-only SQL against it through a deployed MCP-backbone server. Every query is validated, cost-checked and audit-logged server-side.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: The MCP endpoint of a running MCP-backbone server, ending in /mcp/

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: A workspace API key issued by that server (scripts/seed_workspace.py, or rotated from its web console)
